title: When to say “the”
goal: Use “the” when both people know exactly which one
intro: Use “the” when the listener knows exactly which thing you mean: because you mentioned it before, because there is only one, or because the rest of the sentence makes it clear. Use “a” for something mentioned for the first time.

rules.rule: First mention: a. Second mention: the.
examples: I bought a phone. The phone is great.
We saw a movie. The movie was long.

rules.rule: Only one of it exists, or it’s clear which one.
examples: the sun, the moon, the internet
the best day, the same shirt
the first time, the last bus

rules.rule: Instruments, rivers, seas and some countries take “the”.
examples: the Ganga, the USA, the UK

mistakes.wrong: He is best player in the team.
mistakes.right: He is the best player in the team.
I play the guitar every evening.
mistakes.why: British and Indian English use “the” with instruments.

mistakes.wrong: This is first time I’m here.
mistakes.right: This is the first time I’m here.
mistakes.why: first, second, last → the first time

ex.q: She is ___ smartest person I know.
I saw ___ dog in the park. ___ dog was huge.
Mount Everest is highest mountain in the world.
ex.fixed: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

ex.q: Did you finish reading book I gave you?
ex.fixed: Did you finish reading the book I gave you?
My son is learning the piano.

ex.q: Is this ___ first time you are visiting Kerala?

ex.a: This is the best tea in the city.

a: Delhi is the capital of India
ex.y: There is only one capital, so “the”.

talk: Tell the coach about the best trip of your life: where you stayed, what you saw, and the first thing you did. Watch every “the”.
